The public REST API and the billing service behind it

events.text: Could we export report tables as CSV files?

Change request from <@U0ALICE>:
This is a bigger piece of work. Make it a feasibility study of the report tables first.

arguments.title: Export report tables as CSV
arguments.body:
## Problem
People copy report tables by hand when they need them elsewhere.

## Proposal
Export any report table as a CSV file.

## Suggested approach
Drafted by the agent from the discussion; adjust before starting.

1. Add an Export CSV action to each report table.
2. Write the visible columns and rows to the file.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Every report table can be exported as a CSV file

issue.title: Study whether report tables can be exported as CSV
issue.body:
## Problem
People copy report tables by hand when they need them elsewhere.

## Proposal
Before building CSV export, study whether every report table can be exported the same way.

## Suggested approach
Drafted by the agent from the discussion; adjust before starting.

1. List the report tables and how each is built.
2. Note which can be exported as they are, and which need changes.

## Acceptance
- [ ] A short write-up says which report tables can be exported, and what the rest need

expected.summary: One topic and one create_issue proposal, revised once from Alice's change request into a feasibility study: its title and body changed, and Alice revised it.
